News and Events

Stay up to date with the seminars, workshops, campaigns and community activities that bring our mission to life.

Events

Seminars, awareness days, conferences and community events across all nine programmes.

Workshops and Trainings

Capacity-building sessions such as the 21st Century Teaching Skills Workshop with EduTransform at ICCI, the Food Safety and Hygiene Workshop with Quaid-i-Azam University and Islamabad Marriott Hotel, and clean energy, climate, hygiene, health and skills workshops.

Campaigns

International Literacy Day walks, Earth Day and tree plantation drives, and climate, health, hygiene, human rights and youth awareness campaigns.

Community Activities

Distributions, awareness sessions, skills activities, water and WASH work, gardening initiatives, volunteer activities and humanitarian support.
